hero.html:
Level 2 - Beginner 25 min LLD UML

Sequence Diagrams

A class diagram shows who exists; a sequence diagram shows who talks to whom, in what order, and who waits. After this page you can read and draw one fast: lifelines, sync and async messages, returns, and the alt / opt / loop / break boxes, ending with a full "book a seat" flow that maps line by line to running code.
